The '''Solleu River''', or '''River Solleu''', was a large [[river]] which ran through [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Fed by underground tributaries that flowed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] core, Theed was mainly an island that rested in the rivers grasp. The mighty river, adored by both [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the Naboo, ended in Theed at [[Virdugo Plunge/Legends|Virdugo Plunge]], the largest waterfall in the [[City/Legends|city]]. Near the end of the river, it forked creating a small island on which [[Broadberry Meadow]] was situated. The [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Funeral Temple]] crossed the river, which was incorporated into a tradition where the ashes of the [[Death/Legends|dead]] would be deposited into the river.
